hard_gates: the binary reports one deterministic inclusive PostgreSQL schema support interval
the current supported schema returns compatible through admin and restricted runtime inspection
an older schema returns migration_required and serve refuses to listen
a synthetic future schema returns binary_too_old and serve refuses to listen
an unreadable schema version fails closed before provider construction or application writes
the restricted runtime role can execute only the bounded schema-version inspection function
the restricted runtime role cannot read or mutate goose_db_version
database compatibility emits stable JSON without a database URL or credential
database migrate remains an explicit admin operation
package and systemd lifecycle scripts never run database migrations
binary-only rollback is allowed only inside the older binary schema support interval
schema-incompatible rollback is documented as PostgreSQL backup or PITR recovery
